285234368.description:
Petrified Wood Fossil Specimen Natural 13in Brown Green Tan Mineralized Wood
This is a 13-inch specimen of petrified wood, a fossilized wood where organic material has been replaced by minerals. The piece shows natural brown, green, and tan colors with characteristic wood grain and layered texture. It is unpolished with visible mineral deposits and surface roughness, preserving the original structure of the wood. Suitable for collectors of fossils, minerals, and natural history items.
